title: 第40章 下雨天，浇不灭训练的热情
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 哔，哔哔哔——“所有人戴帽子，扎腰带，下楼集合，准备出操！”早上的出操，比预想的推迟了一些，但终归也只是推迟。如陆阳先前预料到那样雷打不动，下雨天浇不灭部队训练的热情。新兵们飞快的跑下楼集合整队，这会儿的雨已经比之前小了很多，但还在下。站在队伍里，陆阳深刻的明白刘天王的那首歌里所唱，“冷冷的冰雨在脸上胡乱的拍”究竟是什么感觉。刺骨，透心凉，拔凉拔凉的......“报告连长同志，全连应到xx人，实到xx人，请指示！”“归队！”“是！”值班员回到队伍里站好。高峰背着手，简单几个口令整了整队伍，看向雨里的所有人。“是不是觉得，下雨了就不用出操，就不用搞体能了？”“特三团的前身是原龙国志愿军十七师303团，先辈们能在零下三十多度的冰天雪地里和敌人顽强战斗，下点儿小雨又算得了什么？”“别说是下雨，就是下冰雹，下火球，下刀子，该训练照样训练。因为你们是军人，你们是龙国军人！”新兵们站在雨中，眼睛一眨不眨的看着连长慷慨激昂，口水混合着雨水像个小花洒一样。但绝大多数人都希望他能赶紧把嘴闭上，这样早点儿跑完，早点儿结束。不然，万一冻感冒，那就不好受了。可高峰却并没有想要停下来的意思。“军人的归宿，就是战场！”“越是极端环境，极端天气，敌人就越是可能会突然发动袭击！”“今天，我们不跑三公里，准确的说不只是单纯的只跑个三公里！”“待会，我们要模拟极端天气下，行军途中遭遇敌机轰炸，在跑步途中会下达各种战术指令，所有人必须不折不扣的完成！”“现在向右转，全部上道！”队伍全体右转，淋着雨，踩着水，啪嗒啪嗒的来到跑道上。同一时间，陆阳的眼前也弹出一道光幕。【检测到新知识点：战术演练（淋雨版）！】【......可对反应力，耐力，意志力提供x3倍速提升！】【友情提示：目前宿主体质较弱，此项训练时间不易过长，否则会引发感冒，鼻塞，发热，头痛等症状！】陆阳愣住了，这还是头回出现友情提示？体质较弱，容易诱发感冒，头疼脑热？虽然觉得有点儿被冒犯，但系统似乎比他更了解自已目前的身体状况。陆阳从小确体弱多病，免疫力也比常人更差，正因如此他才想着进部队锻炼锻炼。但谁知道底子实在太差，导致入伍快一个月了，还处于新兵连中游水平。唯一拿得出手的，只有内务，队列，还有黑板报，这就很尴尬。不过，陆阳也不气馁，因为有个姓韩的老魔和他几乎是同样的天崩开局。山村少年，资质平平，凡人修仙，伪灵根结婴。靠着小绿瓶，疯狂氪丹药，杀人夺宝，这才一步步的“稳扎稳打”的苟到元婴。最终制霸修仙界，成了救苦救难的韩天尊！所以，越是不行，陆阳就越是要迎难直上证明自已！不就是淋雨吗？老家有句话叫：淋淋，肯长！意思是，人就像庄稼那样，淋点雨才长得高长得快。“卧倒！”忽然，高峰一声大吼。前面的老兵班长带头趴下。其他新兵陆陆续续的，跟着一块趴在地上。塑胶跑道湿漉漉的，这一下子直接将大家胸口给潮了一大块，众人全部露出十分嫌弃难受的表情。“匍匐前进！”新兵们全都傻了，因为没学过。这是后头才学的内容，称为战术动作。但没吃过猪肉，总见过猪跑吧？大家跟在老兵后头有样学样，像个大壁虎似的，就这么往前爬。尽管动作非常难看，而且奇丑无比，但至少有那么点儿匍匐前进的样子。可能是顾及的事情太多，身体不太好，姿势也不大对，陆阳只觉胳膊肘和膝盖都火辣辣的疼。再加上来回这么折腾，将雨水和地上的脏水都均匀泼洒到身上，导致他的军装湿哒哒的全部黏在身上。潮湿的地面，不断的下雨，还有持续的低温，这种感觉简直要多难受就有多难受！陆阳也终于在此时，体会到了当兵的不易！“班副！”“帮个忙！”前头，像个大号肥鳄鱼的孔垄回过头，冲着陆阳喊了一声。陆阳小声问：“咋了？”孔垄撅着个大腚：“裤衩子夹腚沟子了，把我扯一下！”陆阳：“扯你大爷，滚犊子！”通常这个时候，周凯东已经抬起一脚，朝着孔垄踹过来了，但这回依旧是无动于衷。这让陆阳心里愈发觉得不踏实，甚至觉得班长的问题要比丁腾飞还要严重。与其说，周凯东放弃了三班，倒不如说他在怀疑自已算不算一个称职的班长？......今回的早操，足足比平时多了两倍时间都不止。在跑步中穿插所谓的模拟战术训练，属实是给新兵们整够呛。就连陆阳都有种，半条命被留在操场上的感觉，浑身上下使不出劲儿不说。尤其是衣服湿哒哒的依然黏着在身上，从内到外全部湿透，弄得人很是烦躁。但他也能够理解这项训练的意义，毕竟真正的战场什么恶劣环境都会碰上。刮风下雨，就不打仗，就不用坚守阵地了？冰天雪地里，先辈们穿着单薄的棉衣，用着最劣质的武器，一口雪一口炒面都能打的十七国联军没脾气，他们这才哪儿到哪儿？新兵们被全部带到食堂，这里已经准备好了干毛巾，还有热乎乎的姜汤给大家驱寒。这是指导员提前就让人司务长准备好的，训练归训练，不能真把大家身体折腾坏了。“来来来，不够还有。”“多喝点儿，发发汗，把寒气逼出来就好了。”陆阳捧着碗，喝着热乎乎的姜茶，莫名有种重新活过来的感觉。尤其是姜汤入口的那一瞬间，辛辣刺激的感觉，立马就让陆阳毛孔大开，舒服的打了个激灵。就在这时，有人注意到食堂窗口多了个小黑板，上头写着“小卖部”三个字。细问之下才明白，这是食堂推出的改进措施，专门为吃不饱容易饿的新兵量身打造。通俗来说就是个简易军人服务社，卖的东西也不复杂，只有泡面，火腿肠，卤蛋，饼干，和面包这五样东西。新兵连营区内里没有小卖部，毕竟是个临时组建的单位，也就百来号人，没那个必要。所以，司务长在挨过一顿骂后开会讨论后决定，在食堂里搞个小窗口。不仅能给食堂创收，也能变相解决少部分新兵吃不饱的问题。这样一来，大家也就不用偷偷摸摸的揣馒头，偷鸡蛋回去。也能体验到购物的快乐，改善改善伙食，换换口味。此举一经推出立马获得所有新兵好评，再也不用担心晚上加练结束会饿肚子睡不着了。而这一举措的促成，还得归功于之前丁腾飞偷炒面的那件事，若不是闹得沸沸扬扬，哪里会有这小卖部？换句话说，丁腾飞此举，也算是歪打正着，变相造福了全连新兵。......吃完早饭，雨已经停了。班长赶紧带着新兵们回去换衣服，防止着凉感冒。上楼时候，依旧有新兵对于食堂小卖部的事儿展开热议。“真是万万没想到，姓丁的那家伙居然为大家做了件好事！”“照理应该他得到表扬才对，怎么反倒成了个闷葫芦，是不是被他们班长挤兑了？”“谁知道呢？我听说他们班长脾气一直不好，新训第一天就给丁腾飞提干了，说不准就是因为这事儿留下心理阴影了，所以人家之后才不停的捣乱？”“我觉得很有可能！有些老兵就是喜欢仗着兵龄长资历老，欺负我们新兵；前几天我去食堂小值日，那个姓刘的二拐就拿鼻孔看我，说话趾高气昂的......”周凯东跟在队伍后头，这一句句话像是一根根刺扎在他心里头。之前只是老兵议论，现在连新兵也这么想。这让周凯东心里不可避免的十分不舒服。人是感性动物，在一个相对封闭的环境里，全是对你的指责和怀疑，很难不受到影响。周凯东很后悔，当时为什么就没能控制住脾气，为什么就没把袋子打开看一眼。但凡知道丁腾飞偷的是炒面，知道那硬邦邦的东西是牛奶，而不是手机。他绝对不可能干出那样的事，更不能把人家自尊心打击成那样。事情发生后，周凯东尝试过道歉，也让陆阳找他谈了，但却无济于事。如果单纯是丁腾飞的问题，他可以置之不理，甚至可以把这个兵直接放弃，可做错的偏偏是他自已。这让他这个当班长的，第一次不知所措，不知该如何是好？忽然，有人扯了扯周凯东的胳膊，回过头发现是陆阳。“班长，别胡思乱想了，没人怪你。”“或许吧。”周凯东回答的有些敷衍，也不知道听没听进去。陆阳也很无奈，他该做的，能做的都做了。明明只是个班副，却为这个班集体操碎了心。回到三班，大家都在抓紧换上干净衣服，但却莫名觉得班里气氛怪怪的。上一次出现这种感觉，还是丁腾飞从禁闭室被放出来那会儿。今回，这种不自在的感觉更加强烈了，像是班上多了两个陌生人......
content_en: Beep, beep beep beep - "Everyone put on their hats and belts and gathered downstairs to get ready for the exercise!" The morning exercise was delayed a little bit more than expected, but in the end it was just a delay.As Lu Yang had previously expected, it would be unstoppable and the rainy day could not dampen the enthusiasm of the troops for training.The recruits quickly ran downstairs to gather together as a team. The rain was now much lighter than before, but it was still falling.Standing in the team, Lu Yang had a deep understanding of what Liu Tianwang's song said, "cold icy rain hitting your face randomly" exactly what it felt like.Biting to the bone, chilling to the heart, and refreshing... "Reporting to comrade company commander, there are xx people in the whole company, and there are actually xx people. Please give instructions!" "Return to the team!" "Yes!" The duty officer returned to the team and stood up.Gao Feng clasped his hands behind his back and ordered the entire team with a few simple commands, looking at everyone in the rain."Do you think that if it rains, you don't need to do exercises or do physical fitness?" "The predecessor of the Special Third Regiment was the 303rd Regiment of the 17th Division of the original Dragon State Volunteer Army. Our ancestors could fight tenaciously with the enemy in the ice and snow at more than 30 degrees below zero, so what does a little rain mean?""Don't say it's raining, it's hail, fireballs, and knives. You should train as usual. Because you are soldiers, you are soldiers of the Dragon Kingdom!" The recruits stood in the rain, unblinkingly watching the company commander's impassioned speech, and their saliva mixed with the rain like a small shower.But most people hope that he can shut his mouth quickly so that he can run out and end it earlier.Otherwise, if you catch a cold, it will be uncomfortable.But Gao Feng had no intention of stopping."The destination of soldiers is the battlefield!" "The more extreme the environment and weather, the more likely the enemy will launch a sudden attack!" "Today, we will not run three kilometers. To be precise, we will not just run three kilometers!" "Later, we will simulate extremeUnder the weather, enemy planes were bombing during the march, and various tactical instructions were issued during the run. Everyone must complete them to the letter!""Turn right now, everyone on the road!" The team all turned right, splashing in the rain and stepping on the water, and came to the runway.At the same time, a curtain of light also popped up in front of Lu Yang's eyes.[New knowledge point detected: Tactical drill (rain version)!】【...can provide x3 speed improvement for reaction force, endurance, and willpower!】【Friendly reminder: The current host is weak, so this training time should not be too long, otherwise it will cause colds, nasal congestion, fever, headaches and other symptoms!] Lu Yang was stunned. Is this the first time a friendly reminder has appeared?Do you have a weak constitution and are prone to colds, headaches and brain fever?Although he felt a little offended, the system seemed to understand his current physical condition better than he did.Lu Yang has been frail and sick since he was a child, and his immunity is worse than ordinary people. Because of this, he wants to join the army to exercise.But who would have known that his foundation was so poor that he had been in the army for almost a month and was still in the middle of the recruit company.The only things that can be used are housekeeping, queues, and blackboard reports, which is very embarrassing.However, Lu Yang was not discouraged because there was an old demon named Han who had almost the same start as him.A young man from a mountain village with mediocre qualifications, a mortal cultivating immortality, and a child with pseudo-spiritual roots.Relying on the little green bottle, frantically spending money on krypton pills, killing people and grabbing treasures, he managed to achieve the Nascent Soul step by step "slowly and steadily".In the end, he dominated the world of immortality and became Han Tianzun who rescued those in need!Therefore, the more difficult it is, the more Lu Yang has to face the difficulties and prove himself!Isn't it just raining?There is a saying in my hometown: If you are wet, you will grow!It means that people are like crops, they grow taller and faster when they get a little rain."Lie down!" Suddenly, Gao Feng yelled.The veteran squad leader in front took the lead and got down.Other recruits followed one after another, lying on the ground together.The plastic runway was wet, and a large piece of wetness was immediately felt on everyone's chest. Everyone looked very disgusted and uncomfortable."Crawling forward!" The recruits were all dumbfounded because they had never learned this before.This is something you learn later and is called a tactical move.But I have never eaten pork, but I have always seen pigs running away, right?Everyone followed the veteran's lead, crawling forward like a big gecko.Although the movement is very ugly and ugly, at least it has the appearance of crawling forward.Maybe it was because he had too many things to worry about, his health was not good, and his posture was not quite right. Lu Yang only felt burning pain in his elbows and knees.Coupled with the tossing back and forth, the rain and dirty water on the ground were evenly splashed on his body, causing his military uniform to become wet and stuck to his body.The wet ground, constant rain, and persistent low temperatures make this feeling as uncomfortable as it gets!At this time, Lu Yang finally realized how difficult it is to be a soldier!"Deputy deputy!" "Help me!" Kong Long, who looked like a big fat crocodile in front, turned around and shouted to Lu Yang.Lu Yang asked in a low voice, "What's wrong?" Kong Long stuck out his butt and said, "My pants are caught in my buttocks. Pull me out!" Lu Yang said, "Tear me off, sir!" Usually at this time, Zhou Kaidong had already raised his foot and kicked Kong Long, but this time he was still indifferent.This made Lu Yang feel more and more uneasy, and even felt that the squad leader's problem was more serious than Ding Tengfei's.Rather than saying that Zhou Kaidong gave up on Class Three, it would be better to say that he was doubting whether he was a competent class leader?...This morning's morning exercises took twice as long as usual.Interspersing so-called simulated tactical training with running is really a nuisance for the new recruits.Even Lu Yang had the feeling of being left on the playground for half his life, unable to exert any energy in his body.Especially the wet clothes still stick to the body, soaking from the inside to the outside, which makes people very irritated.But he can also understand the significance of this training. After all, real battlefields will encounter any harsh environment.If it's windy or raining, there won't be a fight, so there won't be a need to hold on to the position?In the ice and snow, our ancestors wore thin cotton-padded clothes and used the lowest-quality weapons. They had no temper and could defeat the Seventeen-Nation Allied Forces with a mouthful of snow and a mouthful of fried noodles. Where were they?All the recruits were brought to the cafeteria, where dry towels and hot ginger soup were prepared to ward off the cold.This was prepared by the instructor in advance. Training is training, so we can’t really strain everyone’s bodies."Come on, come on, there's not enough." "Just drink more, sweat, and force out the cold." Lu Yang held the bowl and drank the hot ginger tea, feeling inexplicably like he was alive again.Especially the moment the ginger soup entered his mouth, the spicy and stimulating feeling immediately opened Lu Yang's pores and made him shiver in comfort.At this moment, someone noticed that there was a small blackboard in the cafeteria window with the words "Commissary" written on it.After asking carefully, I realized that this was an improvement measure introduced by the canteen, specially designed for recruits who are easily hungry because they don't have enough to eat.Generally speaking, it is a simple service club for soldiers. The items it sells are not complicated, only five items: instant noodles, ham sausages, braised eggs, biscuits, and bread.There is no canteen in the recruit company camp. After all, it is a temporary unit with only a hundred people, so there is no need.Therefore, after being scolded and discussed in a meeting, the chief secretary decided to build a small window in the canteen.Not only can it generate income for the canteen, but it can also solve the problem of insufficient food for a small number of recruits.In this way, everyone no longer has to sneak around to pick up steamed buns and steal eggs.You can also experience the joy of shopping, improve your food, and change your taste.This move was immediately praised by all the recruits as soon as it was launched, and they no longer have to worry about being hungry and unable to sleep after extra training at night.The impetus for this move must be attributed to the incident of Ding Tengfei stealing fried noodles. If it hadn't caused such a fuss, where would this canteen be?In other words, Ding Tengfei's move can be regarded as a mistake, benefiting the whole company's recruits in disguise....After breakfast, the rain has stopped.The squad leader quickly took the recruits back to change clothes to prevent catching a cold.When we went upstairs, there were still recruits discussing the matter at the cafeteria."I never expected that the guy named Ding actually did something good for everyone!" "Of course he should be praised, but why did he become a boring gourd? Was he squeezed out by their squad leader?" "Who knows? I heard that their squad leader has always had a bad temper, and he was promoted to Ding Tengfei on the first day of training. Maybe it was because of this that it left a psychological shadow."I think it's very possible! Some veterans just like to bully us recruits because of their seniority. A few days ago, when I went on duty in the cafeteria, the second-hand man named Liu looked at me with his nose and spoke arrogantly..." Zhou Kaidong followed the team, and these words were like thorns in his heart.Before, it was only the veterans who talked about it, but now even the recruits think so.This made Zhou Kaidong inevitably feel very uncomfortable.Humans are emotional creatures. In a relatively closed environment, it is difficult not to be affected by all the accusations and doubts directed at you.Zhou Kaidong regretted why he couldn't control his temper at that time and why he didn't open the bag and take a look.But Fan knew that what Ding Tengfei stole was fried noodles, and that the hard thing was milk, not a mobile phone.There is absolutely no way he could do something like that, let alone hit someone's self-esteem like that.After the incident happened, Zhou Kaidong tried to apologize and asked Lu Yang to talk to him, but to no avail.If it was simply Ding Tengfei's problem, he could ignore it or even give up the soldier directly, but he was the one who made the mistake.This made him, the squad leader, at a loss for the first time. He didn't know what to do.Suddenly, someone pulled Zhou Kaidong's arm, and when he turned around, he realized it was Lu Yang."Squad leader, stop thinking nonsense, no one blames you." "Maybe." Zhou Kaidong's answer was a little perfunctory, and he didn't know whether he heard it or not.Lu Yang was also helpless. He did everything he should and could do.He was obviously just a class deputy, but he was worried about the class as a whole.Back in Class 3, everyone was hurrying to change into clean clothes, but for some reason they felt that the atmosphere in the class was strange.The last time this feeling occurred was when Ding Tengfei was released from the solitary room.This time, this uncomfortable feeling is even stronger, as if there are two more strangers in the class...
